title: The explicit pulled-back local map family
statement: For schemes X,Y [def-pc-scheme], a map q:Y→X, and an open cover U_0 of X, let F,G be modules on X and F',G' modules on Y. Let κ:F'→q^*F and ρ:q^*G→G' be global maps, using tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Given local maps r_0 between the ordinary restrictions of F and G to U_0, define a family on U=q^*U_0 between the ordinary restrictions of F' and G'. Its component is restriction of κ, followed by the inverse open-cover tensor restriction comparison [def-pc-open-cover-tensor-pullback-comparison], ordinary pullback of r_0 along the cover map U→U_0, the forward comparison, and restriction of ρ. This is a concrete five-map composite, with no existence choice.

lean.statement: def localMapPullbackFamily {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) (U₀ : X.OpenCover.{u}) (F G : X.Modules) (F' G' : Y.Modules) (κ : F' ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback q).obj F) (ρ : (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback q).obj G ⟶ G') (r₀ : ∀ α, (Scheme.Modules.pullback (U₀.f α)).obj F ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (U₀.f α)).obj G) : ∀ α, (Scheme.Modules.pullback ((U₀.pullback₁ q).f α)).obj F' ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pullback ((U₀.pullback₁ q).f α)).obj G'
